LIBRARIAN-TATTERED_SPELL_SCROLL.title: Tattered Spell Scroll
LIBRARIAN-TATTERED_SPELL_SCROLL.descript: At the start of your turn, increase the [gold]front[/gold] Orb's value by {Growth:diff()}.
LIBRARIAN-LIBRARIAN_COMMON_PLACEHOLDER.d: At the start of combat, gain 7 [gold]Fire[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-LIBRARIAN_UNCOMMON_PLACEHOLDER: After the [gold]Fire[/gold] Orb [gold]Settles[/gold], increase its value by 2.
The first card with [gold]Exhaust[/gold] you play each combat is free to play.
LIBRARIAN-LIBRARIAN_RARE_PLACEHOLDER_ONE: At the end of your turn, [gold]Activate[/gold] a random [gold]unlocked[/gold], [gold]extinguished[/gold] Orb.
LIBRARIAN-LIBRARIAN_RARE_PLACEHOLDER_TWO: After the [gold]Growth[/gold] Orb [gold]Settles[/gold], deal 7 [gold]Orb damage[/gold] to a random enemy.
LIBRARIAN-LIBRARIAN_RARE_PLACEHOLDER_THR: At the start of your turn, [gold]Activate[/gold] the last Orb that [gold]Settled[/gold] on a previous turn.
LIBRARIAN-LIBRARIAN_SHOP_PLACEHOLDER.des: At the end of your turn, if no Orbs are [gold]extinguished[/gold], [gold]Settle[/gold] the [gold]front[/gold] Orb one extra time.
LIBRARIAN-RESTORED_SPELL_SCROLL.title: Restored Spell Scroll
LIBRARIAN-RESTORED_SPELL_SCROLL.descript: At the start of your turn, increase ALL Orbs' values by {Growth:diff()}, then [gold]Activate[/gold] the [gold]front[/gold] Orb.
